## 1. ATTENDANCE
Mon–Fri, Africa/Lagos. Open 08:00, close 09:00 sharp. Sign-out window comes from `organisation_settings` (checked every 5 min, idempotent). Leave and field assignments are excluded from 'missing'. **The database / Edge Function must also enforce the 08:00–09:00 window — n8n alone is not security.**

parameters.content:
## 8. ANNOUNCEMENTS — POST /webhook/announcement
Headers: `x-webhook-secret`, `x-verified-user-id` (both set server-side by your proxy / Edge Function after it verifies the user's Supabase session — never from the browser). Body: `title`, `body`, optional `category`. The caller must be an active admin of the organisation (checked in the database). Replies: 200 / 400 / 401 / 403 / 500.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, error: 'invalid_payload', details: $('Announcements | Validate Payload').first().json.errors } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({organisation_id: $env.IRIAD_ORGANISATION_ID, title: $('Announcements | Validate Payload').first().json.title, body: $('Announcements | Validate Payload').first().json.body, category: $('Announcements | Validate Payload').first().json.category, created_by: $('Announcements | Validate Payload').first().json.uid, is_published: true, published_at: new Date().toISOString(), created_at: new Date().toISOString()}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, announcement_id: $('Announcements | Create Announcement').first().json.id, notified: $('Announcements | Prepare Announcement Notices').first().json.rows.length } }}

parameters.content:
## 9. KNOWLEDGE INGESTION — POST /webhook/knowledge-ingest
Headers: `x-webhook-secret`, `x-verified-user-id` (admin). Body: `source_id` (uuid). Flow: auth → validate → source lookup (org-scoped) → extract (files only, via Edge Function `knowledge-extract`) → clean + chunk → NVIDIA embeddings (dimension checked against `EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS`) → replace old chunks → insert → verify → mark `indexed`. Any failure marks the source `failed`, logs to automation_runs and replies 500 — a source is never reported indexed unless every chunk was stored.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, error: 'invalid_payload', details: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Validate Payload').first().json.errors } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({storage_path: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Get Source').first().json.storage_path, file_name: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Get Source').first().json.file_name, file_type: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Get Source').first().json.file_type}) }}

parameters.jsCode: return $('Knowledge Ingestion | Assemble Chunks').first().json.groups.map(g => ({json: {rows: g}}));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({indexing_status: 'indexed', last_indexed_at: new Date().toISOString(), error_message: null}) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, source_id: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Validate Payload').first().json.source_id, chunks: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Verify Inserts').first().json.total } }}
={{ { success: false, error: 'ingestion_failed', source_id: $('Knowledge Ingestion | Build Ingestion Failure').first().json.source_id } }}

parameters.content:
## 10. AI KNOWLEDGE ASSISTANT — POST /webhook/knowledge-chat
Headers: `x-webhook-secret`, `x-verified-user-id`. Body: `question`, `conversation_id` (profile_id in the body is ignored). Role and organisation come from the database, the conversation must belong to the caller, retrieval is filtered by the verified role, retrieved text is fenced as untrusted data, and the model may answer only from it. Replies: 200 / 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 502.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, error: 'invalid_payload', details: $('AI Assistant | Validate Payload').first().json.errors } }}

parameters.url: ={{ $env.SUPABASE_URL }}/rest/v1/chatbot_conversations?select=id&id=eq.{{ $('AI Assistant | Validate Payload').first().json.conversation_id }}&profile_id=eq.{{ $('AI Assistant | Validate Payload').first().json.uid }}&limit=1

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({model: $env.NVIDIA_EMBED_MODEL, input: [$('AI Assistant | Validate Payload').first().json.question], input_type: 'query', encoding_format: 'float', truncate: 'END'}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({query_embedding: $json.data[0].embedding, match_threshold: 0.45, match_count: 6, p_organisation_id: $env.IRIAD_ORGANISATION_ID, p_allowed_roles: [$('AI Assistant | Get Verified Profile').first().json.role]}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({model: $env.NVIDIA_CHAT_MODEL, messages: $('AI Assistant | Build Prompt').first().json.messages, temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 700}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $('AI Assistant | Validate Payload').first().json; const t = Date.now();
return [{json: {rows: [{conversation_id: v.conversation_id, profile_id: v.uid, role: 'user', content: v.question, sources: [], created_at: new Date(t).toISOString()}, {conversation_id: v.conversation_id, profile_id: v.uid, role: 'assistant', content: 'I could not find this in the IRIAD knowledge base.', sources: [], created_at: new Date(t + 1000).toISOString()}]}}];

const a = $input.all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.role === 'assistant');
return [{json: {answer: a ? a.content : '', sources: a ? (a.sources || []) : []}}];

parameters.content:
# IRIAD MASTER WORKFLOW
One workflow, independent trigger branches. A failure in one branch cannot stop another.

**Credentials to attach (names are suggestions):** `IRIAD Supabase` (Supabase API, service-role key) on every HTTP node · `NVIDIA API` (Header Auth: `Authorization: Bearer nvapi-…`) on the 3 NVIDIA nodes · `Gmail` (Gmail OAuth2) on every Gmail node.
**n8n env vars:** SUPABASE_URL, IRIAD_ORGANISATION_ID, N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, APP_BASE_URL, NVIDIA_EMBED_MODEL, NVIDIA_CHAT_MODEL, EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS. If your n8n blocks env access in nodes, set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false.
**Workflow timezone:** Africa/Lagos (Settings).

**ASSUMED SCHEMA — confirm against your database (a wrong name makes that branch fail loudly and email you):**
- `notifications`: organisation_id, recipient_id, title, body, type, link, is_read, created_at + NEW `dedupe_key` (UNIQUE), `email_status`, `email_sent_at`
- `attendance_sessions`: UNIQUE(organisation_id, work_date); morning_opened_at, morning_closed_at, sign_out_opened_at, sign_out_closed_at
- `attendance`: organisation_id, profile_id, attendance_date, check_in_at, check_out_at
- `organisation_settings` (1 row/org): signout_open_time, signout_close_time ('HH:MM'), weekly_report_deadline_weekday (1–7), monthly_report_deadline_day (0 = last day)
- `leave_requests`, `field_assignments` (profile_id, status, start_date, end_date, organisation_id)
- `leave_requests`, `attendance_corrections`, `weekly_reports`, `monthly_reports`: status, organisation_id, updated_at + NEW `submission_notified_at`, `decision_notified_at`; reports use staff_id
- `tasks` (+ `task_assignees.profile_id` FK), `calendar_events` (organisation_id, start_at)
- `generated_reports`: report_type, period_start, period_end, content (jsonb), delivery_status, idempotency_key (UNIQUE)
- `automation_runs`: + NEW `execution_id` (UNIQUE)
- `knowledge_sources`: title/name, source_type ('file'|text), storage_path, file_name, file_type, content_text, visibility, allowed_roles, indexing_status, last_indexed_at, error_message
- `knowledge_chunks`, `chatbot_conversations(id, profile_id)`, `chatbot_messages`, RPC `match_knowledge_chunks` (must return NO rows when p_allowed_roles is null — fix the old SQL)
- Edge Function `knowledge-extract` must return `{ "text": "…" }`
